/bin/zsh -lc "cat run_python && ./run_python - <<'PY'
import app

def raises(exc, fn):
    try:
        fn()
    except exc:
        return
    raise AssertionError(f\"expected {exc.__name__}\")

specs = [{\"call_id\":\"b\", \"weight\":-2}, {\"call_id\":\"a\", \"weight\":3}]
b = app.ToolBatch(specs)
specs[0][\"weight\"] = 99
assert b.snapshot() == [
    {\"call_id\":\"b\",\"version\":None,\"status\":\"pending\",\"value\":None,\"error\":None},
    {\"call_id\":\"a\",\"version\":None,\"status\":\"pending\",\"value\":None,\"error\":None},
]
u1 = {\"call_id\":\"b\", \"version\":5, \"status\":\"success\", \"values\":[4,-1]}
b.ingest([u1])
u1[\"values\"].append(100)
assert b.snapshot()[0][\"value\"] == -6
raises(ValueError, lambda: b.ingest([
    {\"call_id\":\"a\", \"version\":1, \"status\":\"error\", \"message\":\"\"},
    {\"call_id\":\"b\", \"version\":4, \"status\":\"wat\", \"message\":\"bad\"},
]))
assert b.snapshot()[1][\"status\"] == \"pending\"
# Stale results are validated before being ignored.
raises(ValueError, lambda: b.ingest([
    {\"call_id\":\"b\", \"version\":4, \"status\":\"success\", \"values\":[True]},
]))
# Repeated same-version payloads are idempotent; changed payloads reject atomically.
b.ingest([{\"call_id\":\"b\", \"version\":5, \"status\":\"success\", \"values\":[4,-1]}])
raises(ValueError, lambda: b.ingest([
    {\"call_id\":\"a\", \"version\":1, \"status\":\"error\", \"message\":\"ok\"},
    {\"call_id\":\"b\", \"version\":5, \"status\":\"success\", \"values\":[3]},
]))
assert b.snapshot()[1][\"status\"] == \"pending\"
# Newer errors replace success; caller mutations cannot affect retained data.
err = {\"call_id\":\"b\", \"version\":9, \"status\":\"error\", \"message\":\"oops\"}
b.ingest([err]); err[\"message\"] = \"changed\"
raises(ValueError, b.finalize)
assert b.snapshot()[0][\"error\"] == \"oops\"
b.ingest([{\"call_id\":\"a\", \"version\":3, \"status\":\"success\", \"values\":[]}])
result = b.finalize()
assert result[1][\"value\"] == 0
result[0][\"error\"] = \"changed\"
assert b.snapshot()[0][\"error\"] == \"oops\"
assert b.finalize() == b.snapshot()
raises(RuntimeError, lambda: b.ingest([]))
empty = app.ToolBatch([])
assert empty.finalize() == []
raises(RuntimeError, lambda: empty.ingest([]))
assert app.score([], -100) == 0
assert app.score([-3, 8], -2) == -10
print(\"edge checks passed\")
PY"
